source_caption:
Fantastic Four is a superhero movie based on the Marvel Comics team. It follows four astronauts—played by Ioan Gruffudd, Jessica Alba, Chris Evans, and Michael Chiklis—who gain superpowers after being exposed to cosmic radiation in space. They become Mr. Fantastic, Invisible Woman, Human Torch, and The Thing, and must learn to use their powers while facing the villain Doctor Doom.

There’s also a darker reboot, Fantastic Four, which retells the origin story with a more serious tone but received mixed reactions. Overall, the Fantastic Four movies focus on teamwork, family dynamics, and balancing normal life with being superheroes, making them a different kind of Marvel story compared to solo heroes.

source_details.synopsis: Fantastic Four (stylized as Fant4stic in all caps) is a 2015 superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team and the first reboot of the Fantastic Four film series. Directed by Josh Trank and written by Trank, Jeremy Slater, and Simon Kinberg, it stars Miles Teller, Michael B. Jordan, Kate Mara, Jamie Bell, Toby Kebbell, Reg E. Cathey, Tim Blake Nelson, and Tim Heidecker. The film follows a group of intelligent teenagers who build a transdimensional portal, causing them to acquire superhuman abilities.
